title: Members get an email two days before a loan is due
summary: Loans now carry a due date and a reminded-at mark. A daily job finds open loans due within two days, emails the member once and marks the loan, so a reminder is never sent twice. A CloudWatch rule runs the job at 08:00 UTC.
behavior: Members who still have a book two days before its due date get one email with the date. Invalid member addresses now fail loudly instead of bouncing later.

merge_risk.why: A daily job that sends email to every member with a loan due soon: a bug here mails people repeatedly.

effort.why: Small and well tested, but the once-only guard deserves a careful read.

rule_checks.why: The new event rule has no tags block.

steps.title: Loan due dates
steps.why_it_matters: Everything else hangs on dueAt and the reminded-at mark.
steps.explanation: Loan gains dueAt and remindedAt, and dueSoon() says whether an open loan is due within a window (two days by default). Existing loans have no dueAt yet.
check_questions: What does dueSoon do for loans created before dueAt existed?

suggestions.text: Loans saved before this change have no dueAt: getTime() on undefined throws here.

steps.title: Sending reminders
steps.why_it_matters: This decides who gets mailed and makes sure nobody gets mailed twice.
steps.explanation: sendDueReminders loads open loans, skips those not due soon or already reminded, emails the member with the due date and marks the loan. It returns how many were sent.
check_questions: If sendEmail succeeds but markReminded fails, is the member mailed again tomorrow?
Does loading every open loan scale?

suggestions.text: Mark the loan before sending, or a failed markReminded() sends the same reminder every day.

side_effects: one email per loan due soon

steps.title: Daily schedule
steps.why_it_matters: Runs the reminders every day, in the app and in AWS.
steps.explanation: The scheduler registers a due-reminders job every 24 hours, and Terraform adds a CloudWatch event rule at 08:00 UTC.
check_questions: Do both the in-process timer and the event rule run the job, sending twice a day?

steps.title: Address check
steps.why_it_matters: Fails early on addresses that would bounce.
steps.explanation: sendEmail rejects addresses that are not name@domain.

steps.title: Tests
steps.explanation: One test: a loan due tomorrow gets one reminder and is marked.
